items.t: Ukraine accuses SpaceX of restricting Starlink, disrupting military amid Trump pressure
items.d: Ukrainian officials and military units accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of throttling a technology at the heart of their battlefield communications and drone operations.
items.fullText: War in Ukraine Ukraine says new Starlink restrictions disrupt military as it reels from intel gaps and Trump clash Ukrainian officials and military units accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of throttling a technology at the heart of their battlefield communications and drone operations. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Ukraine says military operations disrupted by new Starlink restrictions 04:49 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 14, 2026, 8:51 AM EDT / Updated Oct. 14, 2026, 3:55 PM EDT By Abigail Williams , Dan De Luce , Gabe Gutierrez , Yuliya Talmazan and Jane Lytvynenko Ukraine has accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of undermining its ability to defend itself by limiting Starlink internet services as it reeled from intense Russian ballistic missile attacks that it said came without the usual warning from allies. Musk put the responsibility for the restrictions on President Donald Trump’s shoulders on social media , saying the military version of Starlink, called Starshield, is owned and controlled by the U.S. government. “Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS,” Musk said. A spokesperson for President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told NBC News that the limitations remained in place late Wednesday. Facing pressure from Trump to halt strikes on Russia’s energy industry, Kyiv and its backers have worried that Washington could cut off battlefield support to try to force it into concessions at the negotiating table. Ukrainian officials and their European partners were already scrambling to understand the status of U.S. intelligence-sharing after the lack of alert ahead of two Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv this week, two Ukrainian and two European officials told NBC News. Ukrainian firefighters extinguish a blaze at the site of a Russian missile strike at an apartment building in Kyiv on Wednesday amid the Russian invasion of Ukraine. SK하이닉스가 2013년 12월 세계 최초로 HBM을 상용화하는 과정에도 참여했다. 시상식은 오는 15일 대전 롯데시티호텔에서 열린다. 정지은 기자 jeong@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 정지은 기자 한국경제신문 산업부에서 전자업계를 담당하고 있습니다. 제보 메일 환영합니다. items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in France’s Startups Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem. October 12, 2026 by Nat Ives 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA’s Investments in France NVIDIA has been investing in France’s startup ecosystem, having previously invested in leading technology companies including Alice&Bob, Gradium and Scintil Photonics . Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Doctolib, Entalpic , Genesis AI and Pigment . These startups are innovating to solve challenges across healthcare, materials discovery, physical AI and business planning. Doctolib , a European healthcare technology company, builds agents that free up healthcare professionals to deliver better care, while providing patients with a digital health companion that improves access to care and supports more preventive, continuous medicine. Entalpic , a Paris-based startup, accelerates the engineering of advanced materials at the atomic scale, with particular expertise in surfaces and interfaces for semiconductor manufacturing and next-generation electronics. Genesis AI is a global robotics company developing general-purpose robots with frontier intelligence and capabilities through its foundation models, data collection systems, simulation infrastructure and robot hardware.
